title: [Feature Request] Add an option to hide certain audio streams.
line: Applications in the Audio Volume widget's Applications tab can now be hidden from their ⋮ menu, and shown again from the widget's menu.
explanation: The applet always listed every non-virtual playback and recording stream, with no way to leave out ones the user never adjusts, such as an effects processor that is always running. Streams with a single output device didn't even have a ⋮ menu. Each stream's menu (⋮ button or right-click) now ends with a checkable "Hide <application>" item; hidden applications are stored per widget in a new hiddenStreams config list (keyed by stream kind and application name), so they stay hidden across restarts, and a "Show hidden applications" toggle in the widget's ☰ menu, present only while something is hidden, brings them back dimmed so they can be unhidden.

commits.message:
applet: allow hiding applications from the Applications tab

Streams that are always there but never need changing, like effect
processors, clutter the list. Each stream's menu now has a "Hide" item that
remembers the application, and the applet menu can show hidden ones again.

BUG: 523166

media.caption: Master: Applications tab with three streams; with one output device the streams have no ⋮ menu and right-click does nothing, so there is no way to hide one
Fix: every stream has a ⋮ menu; it ends with a checkable "Hide EasyEffects" item (below "Play audio using" when there are several devices)
Fix: while an application is hidden, the ☰ menu offers "Show hidden applications"
After choosing Hide EasyEffects: only Discord and Firefox are listed (still hidden after restarting plasmashell)
With "Show hidden applications" on, EasyEffects comes back dimmed and its menu shows Hide checked; unchecking it unhides it and the ☰ entry goes away
